packageRules.description: Internal @odata2ts/* sibling packages are managed via release-please and the other odata2ts repos, not Renovate
Group vitest with its coverage plugin
Keep @types/node aligned with the Node 24 runtime major
Automerge safe devDependency patch/minor updates once CI is green
Never automerge major updates - always requires manual review

typescript and ts-morph are a coupled, manually-evaluated core upgrade (ts-morph's major versions bundle a specific TypeScript version internally) - hold back for explicit approval, never automerge. See project notes on the 6.0.3/28.0.0 upgrade and the still-deferred TypeScript 7.0 jump.
